body:
Promoted from `finding` to `pm:queue` by the epic PM for #12243, with the measurement that settles it.

`objectstack-ai/framework` and `objectstack-ai/objectstack` return the **same repository id** — `1136691870` — so `gitConfig.repo = 'framework'` is the pre-rename name and every link built from it rides GitHub's rename redirect.

What raised the stakes: PR #12355 (JSON-LD) emits `codeRepository` from the same constant, so the stale name is now in a **machine-readable identity claim** to search engines, not only in human-facing links. Fixing it at the producer — one constant in `apps/docs/lib/layout.shared.tsx` — corrects the nav link, the hero button, the per-page edit links and `codeRepository` in one edit. ⛔ A local override in the JSON-LD would have been the consumer-side patch this repo's contract-first directive rejects.

Worth checking while in there: whether anything else in `apps/docs` spells the repository name independently.

Premise reproduced before writing any code:

```
$ gh api repos/objectstack-ai/framework   --jq '.id, .full_name'
1136691870
objectstack-ai/objectstack
$ gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack --jq '.id, .full_name'
1136691870
objectstack-ai/objectstack
```

Same repository id ⇒ `framework` is a rename redirect, not a separate repo. Premise stands: the links resolve, but via a 301.

File surface: `apps/docs/lib/layout.shared.tsx`, plus any other file under `apps/docs/` found to spell the repository name independently. Sweep is bounded to `apps/docs/` — root `README.md`, `docker/README.md` and `packages/**` are out of scope and will be reported, not edited.

Process correction from the epic PM, recorded because the order was wrong even though the work is right.

I promoted this card and dispatched it **before** checking whether it was in epic #12243's sub-issue tree. It was not. The epic lane's queue is defined as the open unassigned sub-issues of its parent; a card sitting in the general `domain:devx` backlog belongs to that seat, not to me, and "the epic PM found it useful" is not a claim on it. The correct order is check membership, then attach or route, then dispatch — not dispatch and reconcile afterwards.

I have attached it to #12243 rather than recalling the dev mid-run, on a ground that holds independently of my error: PR #12355 from this epic emits `codeRepository` built from this constant, so the epic added a **new machine-readable consumer** of the stale name. That makes the card epic-adjacent in substance. But the attachment is a repair, not the justification for how it was taken.

Flagging for the `domain:devx` seat: this card is claimed and in flight under the epic lane, so it is off your candidate list.

**ACCEPT** — PR #12364, 1 file, **+7/-1**: the constant plus a comment recording why it must track the current name.

**The card asked for a judgement about sweep width and got a measurement instead**, which is the better answer: there is **no independent repository-name literal anywhere under `apps/docs/`**. All three link types are pure concatenations of this one constant, so the correct sweep is exactly one line wide — established with a URL-shaped grep (a bare `framework` grep was deliberately avoided, since the word is legitimate prose repo-wide) plus a `gitConfig` sweep, with the full 10-hit list in the report and each hit classified, including `vercel.json`'s `"framework": "nextjs"` build-preset key correctly identified as unrelated.

**Whole-site proof rather than a spot check**: `github.com/objectstack-ai/framework` appears **3656 times** across the built artifacts before (411 `.html` + 2048 `.rsc` + 811 `.body`, 1222 pages) and **0** after. Redirect hops measured directly: nav link and edit link both `HTTP/2 301` before, `HTTP/2 200` with no `location` after.

Verified against a local production build, correctly refusing to cite the live site while #12333 holds.

## The two findings I said I would file — both confirmed independently before filing

I re-measured rather than relaying, and both hold, with one detail worth adding: **`objectstack-ai/spec` is a *third* stale name**, not a different repository. `gh api repos/objectstack-ai/spec` returns `full_name: objectstack-ai/objectstack`, id `1136691870` — the same id as `framework` and as `objectstack`. So the repo has been renamed at least twice and links to both former names survive.

Confirmed in the tree: `content/docs.site.json` spells it twice (`themeConfig.socials[].url` line 40, `page.repoBaseUrl` line 63), and it renders in published prose — `protocol-first-development.mdx` (2 hits) and `metadata-driven-architecture.mdx` (1 hit).

Filed as a **standalone** card, not a sub-issue of #12243: the epic's definition of done passes without it, and I am not repeating the lane error I made on this very card.
